component.name: Anatase Browser
component.summary: A web browser provided by Anatase

description.p: Anatase Browser is an open-source browser with three simple goals: working video acceleration so your computer does not overheat, a good ad blocker, and no extra cruft.
It is based on the Chromium project, which is the open-source project behind Google Chrome.
